baseName.value: Astron PLS Product (cold-formed steel elements made of galvanized steel sheets)
Astron PLS Produkt (kalt gewalzte Stahlelemente aus verzinkten Stahlblechen)

generalComment.value: This EPD applies to 1 t of PLS structural steel. PLS are structural steel elements which are made by roll forming or bending thin steel plates to form structural sections with open section forms (Zee, Cee, Sigma, Omega, L-angles, et cetera). The Astron PLS steel elements are of the steel grade S350GD Z275 or S390GD Z275 according to EN 10346. The raw material is galvanized and is on coils.

Baustähle sind un- oder niedriglegierte Stahlerzeugnisse, deren Kohlenstoffgehalt zwischen 0 und 0,6 % liegt. Eisen ist der Hauptbestandteil von Stahlblechen. Der Gehalt an anderen Legierungselementen ist deutlich geringer. Die genaue chemische Zusammensetzung ist für die Stahlsorten S350 und S390 in der EN 10346 festgelegt. Die Oberflächen der PLS-Elemente sind mit einem Zinküberzug versehen.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
Structural steels are non or low-alloy steel products whose carbon content is between 0 and 0.6 %. Iron is the main component of steel sheets. The content of other alloy elements is significantly less. The exact chemical composition is defined for the S350 and S390 steel grade in the EN 10346. The surfaces of PLS elements are covered by a zinc coating. The manufacturing follows the rules in the EN 1090-4 Execution of steel structures and aluminium structures – Part 4: Technical requirements for cold-formed structural steel elements and cold-formed structures for roof, ceiling, floor and wall applications. In the integrated PLS production line, the following steps are executed: uncoiling and straightening of the steel sheet punching of holes cutting to length by shearing roll-forming (80% of volume) or break-pressing (20% of volume) of the desired section bundlingQuality control: ISO 9001 monitoring according to the relevant product standards, e.g. EN 1090 and ETA18-1027, including FPC auditing by third party. 
Technical data: 
This EPD is valid for PLS steel elements of varied dimensions and different forms of delivery. Specific information on dimension tolerances, constructional data as well as mechanical and chemical properties of the used steel can be found in the relevant literature and/or the standards. PLS are always produced from hot-dip galvanized steel of the quality Z275 or equivalent (for example ZA or ZM coatings). The galvanization is performed according to EN ISO 1461 and with mechanical stripping for zinc thickness control. Thickness tolerances are the 'special tolerances' according to EN 10143. 
Declared unit: 
The declared unit is 1 t of PLS cold-formed steel elements made of galvanized steel sheets.

Die Herstellung erfolgt nach den Regeln der EN 1090-4 Ausführung von Stahlbauten und Aluminiumkonstruktionen - Teil 4: Technische Anforderungen an kaltgeformte Stahlbauelemente und kaltgeformte Konstruktionen für Dach-, Decken-, Boden- und Wandanwendungen.

In der integrierten PLS-Produktionslinie werden die folgenden Schritte ausgeführt
Abwickeln und Richten des Stahlblechs
Stanzen von Löchern
Ablängen durch Scheren
Walzprofilieren (80 % des Volumens) oder Abkantpressen (20 % des Volumens) des gewünschten Abschnitts
Bündelung
Kontrolle der Qualität: Überwachung nach ISO 9001 gemäß den einschlägigen Produktnormen, z.B. EN 1090 und ETA18-1027, einschließlich FPC-Auditierung durch Dritte. 
Technische Daten: 
siehe die pdf technischen datentabelle

technologicalApplicability.value:
Structural steel PLS elements are intended for bolted structures of industrial or other non-residential buildings. The PLS elementsare fixed to the main structure (primary structure) and act as a substructurefor the building envelope. They are also called secondary structures. Examples are:
single-storey buildings (industrial fabrication and/or storage halls, exhibition halls, etc.)
multi-storey buildings (offices, shops, schools, car parks, etc.)
other industrial structures (power plants, sports or leisure centers, convention centers, stations, etc.)

PLS-Elemente aus Baustahl sind für verschraubte Konstruktionen von Industriegebäuden oder anderen Nichtwohngebäuden bestimmt. Die PLS-Elemente werden an der Hauptstruktur ("Primärstruktur") befestigt und dienen als Unterkonstruktion für die Gebäudehülle. Sie werden auch als "Sekundärstruktur" bezeichnet. Beispiele sind:
einstöckige Gebäude (industrielle Fertigungs- und/oder Lagerhallen, Ausstellungshallen usw.)
mehrstöckige Gebäude (Büros, Geschäfte, Schulen, Parkhäuser usw.)
andere Industriebauten (Kraftwerke, Sport- oder Freizeitzentren, Kongresszentren, Bahnhöfe usw.)

useAdviceForDataSet.value:
Scope: 
The EPD represents 100% of cold-formed steel elements made of galvanized steel sheets produced by Astron Building S.A. in Diekirch. 
System boundary: 
Type of the EPD: cradle to gate with options, with modules C1–C4, and module D.

The production of PRS structural steel (modules A1–A3) includes raw material extraction, energy generation, waste treatment and all transports up to the factory gate. In accordance with COUNCIL REGULATION (EU) No 333/2011, secondary steel is modelled as part of the product system from the moment they are available as unmixed scrap.
Waste or secondary fuels are not used for production.

Module A4 is not declared due to large variances in transport distances between the production site and the construction site, where the product is installed.

In module A5, the products are delivered to the construction site ready to be installed. Manual installation supported by a diesel-powered mobile crane is assumed, electricity consumption related to electric drilling machines, screwdrivers, etc. is considered to be negligible.
The wooden battens used for storage/transport are assumed to be transported to an incineration plant; the recovered energy is declared as exported energy.

Modules B1 to B7 are not relevant for the declared products. The indicator values of Modules B1 to B7 are thus 0 and not declared in the results table.

In analogy to module A5, manual installation supported by a diesel-powered mobile crane is assumed (module C1). 
A share of 11 % of dismantled products is re-used in a different location and reaches the end-of-waste stage after dismantling (European Commission Technical Steel Research, 2001); the corresponding amount leaves the product system as components for reuse.

In module C2, the remaining 89 % of the dismantled steel construction undergo a recycling (European Commission Technical Steel Research, 2001) via a recycling platform, where the steel is shredded and sorted.

In module C3, shredding and sorting of the disassembled product is assumed for the share to be recycled. The recovered material leaves the product system as materials for recycling.
1 % of the shredded/sorted material is considered dust/loss, which is disposed of in a landfill for inert materials. 
The net amounts of the metals leaving the product system are considered as use of secondary material in Module D.

As stated above, a reuse/recycling scenario in conformity with the European Commission Technical Steel Research (2001) on steel used in construction has been used. The landfilling of shredding/sorting losses is declared in C3. Hence, no impacts are declared in module C4.

Module D contains the benefits beyond the system boundary related to the reuse of the steel structure, leading to the substitution of the production of the corresponding steel structure.
It also contains the benefits and loads beyond the system boundary related to the recycling of steel, which results from the treatment of recycled materials from the point of end-of-waste status to the point of substitution (as loads) and the substitution of primary resources (as benefits).
It also includes the benefits and loads related to the energy recovery from wooden wastes in a municipal waste incineration plant as modelled in Module A5.
Only net flows leaving the product system are considered in module D. The recycled content and the assumed processing losses (e.g., during remelting) are taken from respective ecoinvent 3 datasets; these parameters are used to estimate the input of secondary material and compare it with the output flows of the corresponding material.

Gültigkeitsbereich: 
Die EPD repräsentiert 100% der kaltgeformten Stahlelemente aus verzinkten Stahlblechen, die von Astron Building S.A. in Diekirch hergestellt werden. 
Systemgrenze: 
Von der Wiege bis Werkstor mit Optionen, mit Modulen C1-C4 und Modul D.
